==Description==
'''Release v1.7''' was the nineteenth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 11th of February 2020. It added the [[Electroshocker]] tower.

As with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was no official name for updates. As a result, the name '''Release v1.7''' has been retroactively applied to this update.

This version encompassed two updates, the main Release v1.7.0 update (released 11 February 2020) and the minor Release v1.7.1 (released 14 February 2020).

==Changes & Bugfixes==
===Towers===
*[[Shotgunner|Enforcer]]'s upgrade descriptions are now correct.
*[[Shotgunner|Enforcer]] nerfed.
**[[Shotgunner|Enforcer]]'s bullets now have damage dropoff as they pierce enemies
**Statistical changes:
***'''Base'''
****Range decreased from 9 to 7.
***'''Level 4'''
****Range decreased from +1 to +0.
***'''Level 5'''
****Cost changed from {{Money|6,250}} to {{Money|7,500}}.
*[[Scout]] Level 3 range decreased from +1 to +0.
*[[Rocketeer]] base damage decreased from 6 to 5.
*[[Cowboy]] Level 4 firerate changed from {{Tooltip|1.05 > 0.7|-0.35}} to {{Tooltip|1.05 > 0.6|-0.35}}.

===Enemies===
*[[Gold Guard]] now has a death animation.
*[[Fallen Guardian (Legacy)|Fallen Guardian]] now has a death animation.
*[[Grave Digger (Legacy)|Grave Digger]] now has a death animation.
*[[Molten Boss]] now has a death animation.
*[[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] now has a ''Rage Mode'' ability.
*[[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] now only emits red light during ''Rage Mode''.
*Following enemies now have [[MEGA Servers|MEGA Health]] scaling when there are more than 4 players in a [[MEGA Servers|MEGA Server]]:
**[[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] (15,000 health per player)
**[[Gold Titan]] (6,000 health per player)
**[[Molten Boss]] (2,500 health per player)
**[[Grave Digger (Legacy)|Grave Digger]] (1,000 health per player)
*Following enemies now have [[Partial Electric Immunity]]:

**[[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]]

**[[Freight Fright]]

===Crates===
*[[Xmas 2019 Crate]] is no longer obtainable.

===Miscellaneous===
*[[Codes]] fixed.
*[[Codes]] now display what you redeem.
*Placement and upgrade prices in [[MEGA Servers]] are now increased by 20%, regardless of player count.
*[[Gamemodes]] names changed.
**''Easy (Beginners)'' mode renamed to ''Beginners''.
**''Normal (Intermediate)'' mode renamed to ''Molten''.
**''Hard (Expert)'' mode renamed to ''Golden''.
**''Insane (Impossible)'' mode renamed to ''Fallen''.
